molecule_name: Allogeneic CRISPR-Cas9 Engineered Anti-CD19 CAR T-cells CTX112

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: CTX112 is an allogeneic CAR T-cell therapy engineered using CRISPR-Cas9 technology to target and eliminate CD19-expressing B-cells, commonly found in certain types of B-cell malignancies.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Genetically engineered T-cells express a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that specifically binds to CD19 on target cells, leading to their destruction.

data_notes.record_scope: CTX112 is an investigational allogeneic CAR T-cell therapy targeting CD19, currently under clinical evaluation.
